remarks:
Enjoy the beauty of Lake Ontario waterfront living from this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home. A spacious deck overlooking the lake, complete with a gazebo, provides the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee, entertain guests, or take in breathtaking sunsets and the peaceful sounds of the shoreline.

Inside, you’ll find a comfortable, functional layout, vinyl plank flooring, and vinyl replacement windows.  The range, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, washer, and dryer are all new and are included. Beds, dressers, couch, dining table and kayak will also remain after closing. 

Outside, you’ll enjoy the added benefit of an included lot across the lane, providing valuable parking. The rock breakwall was installed in 2020, helping protect the shoreline while allowing you to enjoy everything Lake Ontario has to offer.

Additional updates include a partial roof replacement completed in June 2026, along with the convenience of laundry in the home—a feature not commonly found in many waterfront properties.

Showings begin immediately, with offers reviewed as they are submitted.
